observations: The previous EOF-dependent read could remain blocked when a descendant retained the stdout writer.
The new readability handler drains output while the command runs and retains at most 65536 bytes.
TERM and exact-PID SIGKILL waits are bounded before the runner returns failure.
AgentStore remains single-threaded and retries after failures, preserving last-good cards and clearing disconnected state on success.
The focused Touch Bar check passed all 18 tests, typecheck, SDK contract check, and build.
platformLimitation: This Linux QA host cannot compile AppKit or exercise physical Touch Bar hardware.
